s: Din erube chatzerot beyom tob ubo d' seipim: im yom tob tzarik erube chatzerot veshittupe meboot nitbaer besimman tqy"ch.
Keshem sheasur latzet chutz lattechum beshabbat ella im ken hinniach erube techumin — kak hu beyom tob. Vekol hilkot techumin nitbaer behilkot shabbat.
Im mannichim erube chatzerot veshittupe meboot veerube techumin miyyom tob leshabbat nitbaer besimman shtz"g vetay"v.

Veim chalu shene yamim tobim shel galuyyot bachamishi veshishshi im meorbin erube chatzerot veshittupe meboot beyom tob rishon al tenay nitbaer besimman shtz"g. Veim meorbin erube techumin al tenay nitbaer besimman ty"v, ayyen sham.
